findings.note: Voter identification; optional restrictive identification requirement: lets a voter opt in to showing a photo ID to vote in person. House passage vote 51-49 on 2022-02-03.

Voter identification; accepted forms of identification: adds photo ID cards issued by certain private entities licensed by state health and social services agencies to the list of accepted IDs. Passage vote 2024-02-09 (House, 85-11).

findings.passage: “A year ago, Election Integrity was a main reason why I decided to run for office,” Williams said. “While I was volunteering in Wisconsin for Trump’s legal team, I saw firsthand how rogue bureaucrats gave a pass to illegal ballot harvesting and committed fraud by illegally curing absentee ballots. Something had to be done, so I ran for office. I promised my constituents that I would fight to stop fraud and safeguard our elections here in Virginia. Passing HB554 in the House is our first big step towards fulfilling that promise.
findings.note: Quoted by the Enterprise newspaper after the House passed HB544 (the article writes HB554 in his quote). He ties the bill to election integrity and to absentee ballot handling.
